import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
ARRAY_SIZE = 10000


def task_func():
    # Generate random integers between 1 and 100 inclusive
    array = np.random.randint(1, 101, size=ARRAY_SIZE)

    # Compute statistics
    mean_value = float(np.mean(array))
    std_value = float(np.std(array))

    # Create histogram
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
    bins = np.arange(0.5, 101.5, 1)
    ax.hist(array, bins=bins, edgecolor="black", alpha=0.7)

    # Plot mean and standard deviation lines
    ax.axvline(mean_value, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Mean")
    ax.axvline(mean_value - std_value, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Std Dev")
    ax.axvline(mean_value + std_value, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2)

    # Labels and title
    ax.set_title("Histogram of Random Integers")
    ax.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.legend()

    fig.tight_layout()

    return array, mean_value, std_value, ax
